_note: The source of truth for Blob Knight Rumpler's achievements. Run achievements/inline.py after editing: it writes the ACHV block into blob-knight-rumpler.html and regenerates achievements/README.md. 'stat' names a counter the game keeps; 'need' is the target. Core stats: w wins, ko knockouts, a1 basic attacks landed, a2 specials landed, sig the core's signature feat, fl flawless wins, hard wins against Hard or Expert.
